title: Late-Cancellation Loss Entries for Free Night Awards
content:
## Rule

When a reservation is cancelled after its deadline, the award that pays its first night is forfeited, and its loss record states the stay's protected value: the points value at which the late-cancelled stay stays protected for the member. Any top-off points the member had added to that award are lost with the award and recorded on the loss entry as its top-off.

The loss record of a Free Night Award forfeited on a reservation cancelled after its deadline states the stay's protected value, as the Free Night Awards terms work it out, rather than repeating the price recorded on the hold.

The first night is the night of the cancelled reservation's arrival date; whether the cancellation came after the deadline is shown on the reservation as its cancellation timing.

## Situation of use and capability

`forfeit_late_cancel_award_5a86721d` records the loss of a Free Night Award that paid the first night of a reservation cancelled after its cancellation deadline. It closes one award as lost: the award's status becomes forfeited, its closing date is set to the current date, and one loss entry is added to the award's history naming the award, its reservation and night, the stay's protected value given in the call, the top-off points the award carried, the current date and the reason that the reservation was cancelled after its deadline. Afterwards the award shows as forfeited in the member's account and the loss appears in its history.

## How it is invoked

This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `forfeit_late_cancel_award_5a86721d`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `certificate_id` | The reference number of the Free Night Award being recorded as lost, read from the member's award records | Identifier, as the award record shows it |
| `reservation_id` | The reference number of the cancelled reservation whose first night the award paid, read from the member's reservation records | Identifier, as the reservation record shows it |
| `award_points_price` | The stay's protected value the loss entry states | Integer points: a whole number of points, no decimals, never negative |

The top-off points on the loss entry and the night are not parameters: the loss entry takes them from the award itself.

## Return

On success the tool returns a text rendering of a dictionary with:

- `activity_id`: the reference number of the new loss entry;
- `certificate_id`: the award closed;
- `status`: always `forfeited` on success;
- `closed_date`: the date the award was closed, written YYYY-MM-DD;
- `award_points_price`: the integer points recorded on the loss entry.

Receiving this dictionary means the award is closed as lost.
